result.rationale: The diff's rewritten createAllCalendarEvents iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and in the else branch (destination without credentialId) does `createdEvents = createdEvents.concat(await Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event))))`, filtering credentials by `c.type === destination.integration`. With two destinationCalendar entries of the same integration type and no credentialId, the fan-out runs once per destination, creating duplicate events for the same booking on the same credentials. The mechanism is fully visible
